test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correctly spelt word is '**Shedule**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Shedule**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Schedule**'. • It means 'a plan of things that will happen or of work that must be done'. (होने वाली बातों या किए जाने वाले काम की योजना; समयसारणी, कार्य-योजना) • *Example: Madhuri has a busy **schedule** for the next few days.* **Correct Answer:__** *Shedule.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Sheet**: a large piece of material used on a bed. [बिस्‍तर (पर बिछाने) की चाद] • **Shade**: an area that is out of direct sunlight and is darker and cooler than areas in the sun. [छायादार क्षेत्र (सूर्य के प्रकाश से परे कुछ अँधेरा तथा अपेक्षाकृत ठंडा स्‍थान)] • **Sheath**: a cover for a knife or other sharp weapon. (चाक़ू या पैने हथियार का खोल, आवरण, म्‍यान) 40:T98b, The correct answer is **No substitution required**.
